d:
Elon Musk spent nearly $474 million to influence the 2026 US Midterm Elections, but the results delivered a major political setback. Democrats made significant gains in Congress, while Musk-backed Republican candidates faced defeats in Texas and several other key races.
From Donald Trump and DOGE to political donations, campaign controversies, potential congressional investigations, Starlink's role in Ukraine, and Musk's ambitious SpaceX and AI data center plans, this video explores what the election results could mean for the world's richest man.
